databases.name: Pinecone
databases.free_tier_notes: Free Starter plan: 1 index, ~100k vectors, single project, limited throughput
databases.best_for: production-grade managed vector search with minimal ops overhead and low-latency retrieval
databases.limitations: proprietary managed-only service; vendor lock-in; cost scales with vectors and pod size

databases.name: Weaviate
databases.free_tier_notes: Weaviate Cloud Sandbox free tier with limited storage and short-lived clusters
databases.best_for: modular vector database with built-in vectorization modules and hybrid search (BM25 + vectors)
databases.limitations: operational complexity at scale; smaller community than alternatives; module system adds learning curve

databases.name: Qdrant
databases.free_tier_notes: Qdrant Cloud free 1GB cluster with no time limit
databases.best_for: high-performance self-hosted vector search with rich payload filtering and Rust-native speed
databases.limitations: younger ecosystem than Pinecone; smaller plugin/community footprint

databases.name: Milvus
databases.free_tier_notes: Zilliz Cloud free tier with limited storage and request volume
databases.best_for: billions-scale distributed vector search with GPU acceleration and multiple index types
databases.limitations: higher operational complexity; heavier resource footprint; overkill for small datasets

databases.name: Chroma
databases.free_tier_notes: Free, fully open-source self-hosted (no managed cloud tier currently)
databases.best_for: developer-friendly embeddings store for prototyping and small-to-medium RAG applications
databases.limitations: limited scaling for very large collections; primarily Python-centric; no managed cloud yet

databases.name: pgvector
databases.free_tier_notes: Free open-source extension; managed PG providers (Supabase, Neon, RDS) include pgvector in free tiers
databases.best_for: lightweight vector search inside existing PostgreSQL workloads without adding infrastructure
databases.limitations: performance lags behind purpose-built vector DBs at scale; index options more limited
